description: Find all Belgian statutes that implement a specific EU directive or regulation. Given an EU document ID (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR), returns Belgian implementing statutes with implementation status (complete/partial/pending). Use this to answer "Which Belgian laws implement [EU directive]?"

eu_document_id.description: EU document ID in format "type:year/number" (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR, "directive:2016/1148" for NIS). Type is "directive" or "regulation".

in_force_only.description: Return only currently in-force statutes (default: false).

primary_only.description: Return only primary implementing statutes (default: false).

name: get_belgian_implementations
